work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory records, checked incoming deliveries against purchase orders, and referred discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Prepared order paperwork, coordinated dispatch schedules with warehouse staff, and tracked outstanding requests through routine follow-up with suppliers.

projects.title: Regularized Logistic Regression for Tabular Classification
bullets: Implemented a logistic regression baseline using scikit-learn, with missing-value imputation and feature standardization fitted exclusively on training data.
Selected regularization strength through stratified cross-validation and compared held-out discrimination and calibration against an unregularized baseline using ROC curves and reliability diagrams.
